title: DeviceProfile
description: One Vulkan physical device as discovery recorded it (DESIGN.md § 5.1).

subgroup_size.description: VkPhysicalDeviceSubgroupProperties.subgroupSize; absent where the driver does not state it (a device below Vulkan 1.1) (DESIGN.md § 5.1 subgroup properties).

subgroup_stages.description: VkPhysicalDeviceSubgroupProperties.supportedStages, by VkShaderStageFlagBits name; empty where `subgroup_size` is absent (DESIGN.md § 5.1 subgroup properties).

subgroup_operations.description: VkPhysicalDeviceSubgroupProperties.supportedOperations, by VkSubgroupFeatureFlagBits name; empty where `subgroup_size` is absent (DESIGN.md § 5.1 subgroup properties).

f16_storage.description: VkPhysicalDevice16BitStorageFeatures.storageBuffer16BitAccess; absent where the driver does not state it (a device below Vulkan 1.1) (DESIGN.md § 5.1).

f16_compute.description: Whether shaders may do f16 arithmetic (VkPhysicalDeviceShaderFloat16Int8Features.shaderFloat16); absent where the driver does not state it (a device below Vulkan 1.2); without it there is no f16 compute path (DESIGN.md § 5.1, § 8.1 E-TARGET-034).

cooperative_matrix.description: Whether the driver exposes a cooperative-matrix extension (DESIGN.md § 5.2, M4).

vulkan_api_version.description: VkPhysicalDeviceProperties.apiVersion, packed as Vulkan packs it (DESIGN.md § 5.1).

spirv_version.description: Highest SPIR-V version the device accepts, packed as in the SPIR-V header (DESIGN.md § 5.1).

cooperative_matrix_shapes.description: The actual supported matrix types and M/N/K shapes; empty when `cooperative_matrix` is false (DESIGN.md § 5.2).

shader_rounding_mode_rte_f32.description: The driver value of VkPhysicalDeviceFloatControlsProperties.shaderRoundingModeRTEFloat32; absent where the driver does not state it (a device below Vulkan 1.2) (DESIGN.md § 5.4).

shader_denorm_preserve_f32.description: The driver value of VkPhysicalDeviceFloatControlsProperties.shaderDenormPreserveFloat32; absent where the driver does not state it (a device below Vulkan 1.2) (DESIGN.md § 5.4).

shader_signed_zero_inf_nan_preserve_f32.description: The driver value of VkPhysicalDeviceFloatControlsProperties.shaderSignedZeroInfNanPreserveFloat32; absent where the driver does not state it (a device below Vulkan 1.2) (DESIGN.md § 5.4).

modelspec.device.CooperativeMatrixShape.title: CooperativeMatrixShape
modelspec.device.CooperativeMatrixShape.description: One VkCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR entry, component types by Vulkan enum name (DESIGN.md § 5.1).

modelspec.device.Extent3D.title: Extent3D
modelspec.device.Extent3D.description: A size along the three workgroup dimensions x, y and z, each positive (DESIGN.md § 3.1 dispatch dimensions, § 5.1 workgroup limits).

modelspec.device.MemoryHeap.title: MemoryHeap
modelspec.device.MemoryHeap.description: One Vulkan memory heap and its budget (DESIGN.md § 5.1 memory heaps/budgets).

budget_bytes.description: VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryBudgetPropertiesEXT.heapBudget; absent where the driver does not expose VK_EXT_memory_budget (DESIGN.md § 0 invariant 6, § 5.1).
